items.description: DataOrigin is a trade show prospecting / event intelligence platform for B2B sales teams: it provides exhibitor, attendee, speaker and sponsor lists of trade shows enriched with firmographic data and scores companies against the user's ICP; founded 2024, based in Valencia, Spain

Sign-up gives 150 free credits (1 credit = 1 EUR); trade shows are unlocked from the catalog with credits; credit packs and subscriptions are shown only inside the platform after signup, quotes via contact page
Not a generic B2B contact database (data organized around trade shows/events), does not cover B2C consumer fairs or individuals, and does not register users for events or sell tickets
Exports to CSV, Excel, Google Sheets and integrates with CRMs HubSpot, Zoho and Pipedrive; API connection for data export; finds decision-makers for email/LinkedIn outreach
Solution page explaining how DataOrigin helps B2B sales teams identify and prioritize companies at each trade show using their ICP
Signup page for the app (150 free credits)
Contact page to request a demo, information or pricing quote
Solutions by team pages (sales teams, B2B marketing, B2B software, trade show organizers, trade show suppliers), in English and Spanish
Trade show calendar with dates, cities and sectors grouped by month, updated automatically
Trade shows by industry sector listing pages (agriculture, cybersecurity, energy, pharma, etc.), in English and Spanish
Glossary of B2B trade show and event terms (trade show, exhibitor list, MICE, lead scoring, ICP, etc.), in English and Spanish
Event directory pages: upcoming trade shows and business events across Europe, and events by month
Free tools and resources: trade show ROI calculator, B2B trade show statistics with sources, event budget template with downloadable CSV
llms-full.txt with expanded text of main pages
Browser extension for Chrome and Firefox to find company contacts while browsing
